name: cicy-koubo
title: Cicy Koubo
description: Install and operate the source-free cicy-koubo spoken-video app, defaulting to temporary Cicy Cloud GPUs while supporting optional local NVIDIA WSL2 and Colab workflows.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: 口播工作台
zh-CN.description: 无源码安装并操作 cicy-koubo 口播工作流，默认使用按需创建和释放的 Cicy Cloud GPU，也支持 WSL2 本机 NVIDIA GPU 与 Colab。

tools.name: setup
tools.description: Install the local UI, select temporary Cicy Cloud GPU, and start the workspace

tools.name: gpu
tools.description: Select Cicy Cloud, local NVIDIA, or Colab as the GPU provider

tools.name: install
tools.description: Install the npm application and prepare runtime dependencies without source

tools.name: start
tools.description: Start the workspace in the background and open it with agent-electron profile 1

tools.name: open-or-start
tools.description: Activate an existing profile-1 workspace tab, or start and open the service when absent

tools.name: status
tools.description: Report package, process, HTTP, URL, version, environment, and log status

tools.name: restart
tools.description: Stop the managed process, start it again, and reopen the workspace

tools.description: Run the project's build and restart it when it was running

tools.description: Refresh the npm application and restore its prior running state
